limits: Synthetic two-event/one-opportunity experiments only. No human workload, understanding, full-calendar stacking or release-balance finding. Price is not roster strength. Target hiring can change later offers/opponent roster; philosophy build prices may differ. Unaffordable builds explicitly retain the minimum car; rejected investments explicitly commit Save, never receive free credits. Final-event delay cannot complete in this calendar.
hypotheses: Expensive legal acquisition can leave less room for development: inspect rejected investment and retained credit rows; reject/inconclusive when data disagree.
Investment need not improve the final weekend: retain partial, delay, compromise, retirements and slower paired rows.
Reinforcement need not outperform complementary refinement at Monaco: compare complete seedwise rows, not a selected success.
One short opportunity cannot settle season-long runaway risk: report actual lead/margin changes and leave full-calendar claim inconclusive.
